text: Does withdrawing every purpose-diagnostic channel impair recognition? R2 finds a cost above 0.02 nats in all eight tested 16- and 32-step settings. The strongest setting is nominated after two batches at 0.17372 nats, with a descriptive 95% interval of 0.15550–0.19195. Benign false alarms carry the accuracy cost; release does not uniformly preserve protection. This is a constructed-method discovery, not confirmation or evidence about people.
